mixed_source_rule: Mixed-source event records are explicitly permitted by inherited POINT_IN_TIME_RULES; each field carries its own source identity, publication timestamp/audit trail and hash.
timestamp_rule: Every field source must be strictly pre-T0. TeleTrade same-day schedule requires an explicit page timestamp before 12:30/13:30 UTC. Baker issue must have internal printed-as-of before T0.
version_rule: TeleTrade must expose stable article identity/date-time; Baker must expose static PDF identity and printed-as-of.
conflict_rule: No averaging. The frozen field source wins for its field; conflicting values are recorded but do not trigger substitution.
missing_rule: Any missing one of the four required fields makes that event incomplete.
